# xts1

## Files

- network.nix
- default.nix

## File Summaries

### network.nix
Static network configuration for xts1 BGP/keepalived require stable IPs — xts1 is always 172.18.10.1

### default.nix
NixOS ARM host configuration for xts1, imports boot, hardware, and Raspberry Pi modules.

### minimal.nix
Minimal SD image configuration for xts1; deploy with deploy-rs after boot.
